All direct call return sites in src/asm/GAME.ASM

purpose: Borrow geometry and choose the first touching player, or the first eligible descending/stationary thrown stone hitting the selected enemy. No persistent state or generic object-state abstraction.

inputs: ObjectPosition current X32/Y32 words, arbitrary geometry anchor/extent words, two player positions and arbitrary 16-bit PlayerCount
StoneContactView[0..16] with projected descriptor+handler eligibility, arbitrary position/vertical-step words, and enemy position
Ordinary stable RAM for bridge reads; source words may be correlated/aliased but are not mutated or asynchronously changed
outputs: ContactProbe ordinary touching value and last constructed wrapped boundary; ContactSelection slot number or -1 and boundary diagnostic
Bridge DI=2*slot or FFFF; AX actor platform on hit, otherwise last constructed boundary; stone miss AX=FFFF
Final TEST-DI SF/ZF/PF and cleared CF/OF; preserve IF/DF and unrelated shell. The bridge additionally reproduces deterministic L1 AF though L0 TEST leaves AF undefined
effects: Reads supplied inputs only; no native/bridge RAM writes, callbacks, allocation, globals or I/O
Bridge may read stable fields earlier than L0 short-circuit order; extra ordinary RAM reads have no semantic side effects
preconditions: All scalar word patterns admitted: negative coordinates/extents, wrapping arithmetic, reversed signed bounds and nonstandard counts are not excluded
Native stone count<=16, initialized accessible array and no output/input alias; bridge finds exact FFFF descriptor sentinel at index<=16
Corrupt/unterminated lists beyond this bound call the retained L1 endpoint explicitly, rather than being treated as a native result
Normalized symbolic proofs bind BX=0, SI=0100, DS=0 to independent read-only fields. Physical source projection/offset wrap has separate C evidence; no device/live mutation semantics are abstracted
interface.player_bounds: Let W truncate to 16 bits and S interpret a word as signed. Inclusive bounds: S(W((anchorY-2*extentY)*32+objectY-640)) <= S(playerY) <= S(W(anchorY*32+objectY)); S(W((anchorX-extentX)*32+objectX-832)) <= S(playerX) <= S(W((anchorX+extentX)*32+objectX-160)). Every CMP uses independently wrapped endpoints, never a wrapped difference sign.
interface.item_geometry: Item descriptor +0/+2 become anchorX/anchorY, with extentX=extentY=3 (vertical subtract six), independent of descriptor callback fields.
interface.stone_bounds: Inclusive enemyY in [S(W(stoneY-640)),S(W(stoneY+256))], enemyX in [S(W(stoneX-832)),S(W(stoneX+384))]. Eligibility requires exact stone descriptor, exact thrown update handler, and vertical-step sign clear (zero accepted).
interface.search_order: Always test player 0. Only PlayerCount==2 retries player 1 after miss. Stone scan proceeds ascending slot order to the first exact FFFF descriptor; wrong descriptor, wrong handler or negative vertical step skips. Never choose nearest.
interface.cached_geometry: These DOS predicates read current fixed-point positions and descriptor words, not cached draw/pixel positions or current sprite dimensions. Do not refresh/derive geometry from a renderer cache.
interface.flags: Known direct callers branch immediately on SF. Actor hit MOV AX,platform follows TEST DI, so platform FFFF does not indicate miss. ZF indicates slot zero, not a general hit boolean. PF follows low DI parity. Full L1 flags are retained as a conservative bridge contract.

indirect.classification: Leaf predicates. Stone handler words are compared/classified, never called. Known caller graph is conservative, not an unrestricted external-entry proof.
